description: Head of household; one W-2 ($30,000 wages, $1,000 withheld); one qualifying child age 5 who lived with the taxpayer all 12 months. The tentative $2,200 child tax credit exceeds the $638 Tax Table liability, so $638 is nonrefundable and the unused $1,562 comes back as the additional child tax credit. Money values below are integer cents. EIC LANDING NOTE (supersedes the pre-EIC values): with the earned income credit implemented, line 27 is $3,261, so lines 32/33/34 are $4,823/$5,823/$5,823 (they were $1,562/$2,562/$2,562 when line 27 was not implemented). The input also gained the child's SSN: the EIC counts only children with an SSN in v1; the Schedule 8812 amounts do not depend on it and are unchanged.
